test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is formed by folding the given sheet. What would be the number on the opposite side of number '76'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cb557fb6633ded8798dfe283c4397f493ecf6d66990eb743d9db11d5926ef5b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507fc2a0301fd05c6fc60b82899589fc29a32001361ba78cbceca38fb8c585cf.png] 

68 is opposite to 41

35 is opposite to 76

90 is opposite to 24

So, the number opposite to 76 is 35.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (2).**
